senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) reduction of a debt against a landed security (מַשְׁכַּנְתָּא) by deducting a stipulated amount every year for usufruct.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 67b:4">B. Mets. 67ᵇ</cite> top <he>האי משכנתא … לא ניכול אלא בנ׳</he> where the usage prevails that a land pledge can be redeemed at any time, the creditor must not have the usufruct except for the consideration of a rent deductible from the debt, v. <cite ref="M02910"><he>מַשְׁכַּנְתָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 67b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>בלא נ׳</he> without paying any rent by deduction.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 62a:15">Ib. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>משכנתא בלא נכיתא</he> (Rashi <he>נכיי׳</he>) in the case of usufruct from pledged land without consideration; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:7">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מה נ׳</he> ed. Lehm., v. <cite ref="E00685"><he>הַנְכָּיָיה</he></cite>.
